items.title: Albert Artigues Sr. Interview, 1961-12-15
items.q: And Katz and I used to bum together those days.

ctx.x: He's a clock But he is

Not like that That's why I like Katz Maistre You see Katz is a drummer? And he sets a tempo and that's it You can't accuse him of picking up time If time was picked up in a band One of the other instruments done it Katz didn't do it He is really on the ball, man Played a nice set of drums
Alfred Williams today When you hear him the only thing he does Is get louder Yeah But he never changes anything, you know He keeps that same beat going
